Capture observes only already validated lifecycle points and records the exact normalized input, current session events and artifacts, route and planning inputs/results, portfolio request/result, descriptor and binding inventories, initial and reconciled parent ledgers, canonical Evidence, Certificate and checker decisions, and safe attempt classifications.

Raw environment values, credentials, inherited secrets, argv and shell text, executable and workspace paths, host or user identity, PID, handles, clock samples, temporary names, raw failed stdout or stderr, tracebacks, diagnostic prose, and arbitrary caller metadata are absent from all canonical audit objects and metadata.

Event order is derived only as run-open, input-bound, plan-bound, each strategy visit and reached producer/evidence/checker/decision/transition phase in exact attempt order, and run-close; ordinals are contiguous and each event binds the prior event digest.

Every object record binds an allowlisted role, deterministic role ID, optional governed portfolio binding role, schema identity, exact length and full SHA-256; record order is canonical and semantic role IDs are unique while physical bytes deduplicate by digest.

The logical report records the normalized input, exact route and plan, selected plugin and components, declared parent budget limits, governed artifact identities, stable attempt and checker classifications, transitions, selected checked result and authority tier while excluding runtime ledger and platform observations that are not semantic.

The bundle and every public nested value are final immutable codec-owned values; direct construction, subclassing, mutation, alias mutation, dataclass replacement, pickling, repaired hashes, or copied status fields cannot produce a valid bundle.

The audit bundle and logical report always have mathematical_authority false; selected proof or refutation authority remains solely in the independently checked exact Evidence and Certificate chain governed upstream.
MemoryError, KeyboardInterrupt, and SystemExit propagate after the active isolated-worker cleanup behavior and never become a completed audit or mathematical result.

epistemics.audit: records exact validated execution evidence and safe classifications but is never itself proof, refutation, Certificate, checker, or mathematical authority
epistemics.checker: checker decisions and Certificates are retained only after exact independent upstream validation and retain their original authority tier without elevation
epistemics.invalid: incomplete, missing, stale, over-budget, or internally inconsistent capture cannot return a valid bundle or checked promotion
epistemics.producer: producer bytes are retained only when they parse as an allowlisted governed artifact; invalid raw output contributes only safe digest-free classification metadata and cannot self-attest
epistemics.replay: future replay may validate logical consistency and accepted checker links but does not rerun producers or mint authority
epistemics.resource: budget ledgers and exhaustion document execution bounds only and never prove or refute a mathematical claim

invariants: One audited call corresponds to exactly one portfolio call and one terminal portfolio result; capture never retries, speculates, reruns, substitutes, or changes accepted transition behavior.

The nested route request normalization identity names exactly one present object; every named session event and artifact is present and every supplied portfolio artifact is bound without surplus, omission, duplicate role, or stale digest.

Every planned strategy has exactly one descriptor and execution binding, and every visited attempt names that exact strategy, transition, producer/checker components, Evidence and checker decision identities.
Initial, intermediate, and final parent-ledger identities form the exact observed sequential chain; no hidden lease, refund, inferred usage, or caller-authored accounting is accepted.

Canonical logs contain allowlisted validated mathematical and governance objects only; ambient effect inputs and unvalidated output are excluded as complete field classes rather than pattern-redacted.

Event subject digests are sorted unique, event ordinals are contiguous, the root previous link is null, every later previous link is exact, and run-close binds the terminal portfolio result and logical report.

The logical report is a deterministic projection of validated objects and portfolio semantic metadata; it contains no raw runtime ledger, filesystem, process, environment, clock, or diagnostic payload.

A successful portfolio audit retains exactly one selected Evidence, Certificate, checker decision and strategy; non-success audits retain none as selected authority while preserving validated nonselected artifacts only as non-authoritative history.
No callable, module, plugin instance, file object, path object, process object, Event, mutable mapping, mutable sequence, secret container, or unbounded iterator is stored in a public value.
All schema, contract, content, event, report and manifest identities are independently recomputable and any repaired outer digest with stale inner content fails.
